title: Report transaction count by merchant
sqlValidation:
SELECT
    m.id,
    m.merchantName,
    COUNT(wt.merchantId) AS transactionCount
FROM dbo.Merchants m
LEFT JOIN dbo.WalletTransactions wt ON wt.merchantId = m.id
GROUP BY m.id, m.merchantName
ORDER BY transactionCount DESC;
sqlExpectedResult: Merchants are ranked correctly by transaction count.
